limitations: Full text of the paper (J Hypertens 2015;33:126-135) could not be retrieved (Europe PMC: not in PMC; publisher page behind Cloudflare; no repository copy); only the abstract, MeSH headings and PRIDE protocols were used.
Developmental stage / age not stated in available evidence: not available.
Analysed material is tissue (interstitial) fluid extracted by centrifugation from dissected cortex pieces; there is no SDRF column/term used to express this beyond the organism part region.
The abstract states the 2K1C comparison used the non-clipped kidney; kidney side is not stated in available evidence and is not encoded.
SHAM_11OC.raw was excluded from the Progenesis quantification by the authors (technical failure of MS read-out); it is still deposited and annotated.
Modifications come from the dataProcessingProtocol prose; no deposited search-parameter file (only a Progenesis protein export).
Sex of sham controls inferred from MeSH 'Male' and study-level description; no per-animal table.
